name: Ichijin Yuuto
source:
Likes: Gizajuu (10 yen coins produced from 1951 to 1958)
Dislikes: Stepping on water puddles that he thinks will do something to him

The protagonist who was summoned into Alternia. While he has been very unlucky throughout his whole live, Yuuto tries his best to stay positive and find happiness in small things. He also believes that it's important for people to help out each other.
